people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

translations.web: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
translations.bsb: They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translations.kjv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
translations.asv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
